title: Saturn AI premium-output visual review rubric
description: Shape of the rubric produced by scripts/review-grade.mjs and consumed by the fresh-context reviewer subagent described in policy.ts and the three packaged SKILL.md guides. One item per pre-ship checklist entry in scripts/harness/SATURN-DESIGN-RULES.md ('Pre-ship checklist'), in that document's order. score/verdict follow the SPEC §5 Mars rubric shape ({criterion, score 1-5, evidence, verdict}), extended with UNVERIFIED for a checklist item a static probe genuinely cannot judge (never a guessed PASS) — the honest-instrument posture this package's collect-evidence.js-derived probes already carry.

source.description: Path or label of the rendered page this rubric grades.

engine.description: The static-DOM engine used to resolve computed styles (e.g. 'jsdom@<version>'), or 'unavailable' when the probe degraded.

overallVerdict.description: REJECT if any mechanically-scored item is REJECT; else REVISE if any is REVISE; else PASS. UNVERIFIED items never gate this and must still be surfaced to whoever reviews the rubric.

notes.description: Instrument-level caveats (degraded mode, unreadable stylesheet, missing layout engine, etc.) — never silently dropped findings.

findings.description: Raw named tells behind the scored items (gradient stops, uniform-card groups, fade-up census, etc.), for a human or subagent reviewer to inspect directly.

enum: Spacing, type roles, and real imagery
One primary CTA per section; real routes

score.description: 1 (fails) through 5 (clean); null only when verdict is UNVERIFIED.

evidence.description: What was actually measured, or why the item is UNVERIFIED. Never a bare 'looks good'.
